summary: Inspected thys/HOL-CSP_RS/Dali_Combined.thy (54KB), the only file changed since the prior review. This file contains a full CSP formalization of the Dali durable linearizability model (from the IFM 2025 article by Edmonds et al.). It defines datatypes for nodes, keys, pointers, values, threads, and epochs; a locale `Dali` parameterized by capacity bounds; mutually recursive process definitions (NodeHandler, PointerHandler, BucketVarHandler, GlobalEpochHandler, application Thread, WorkerThread, Recovery, etc.) using `Fixrec`; the composed system processes `Dali`, `DaliL`, `DaliE`, and an abstract map specification `Spec`; plus numerous lemmas about trace properties, hiding, and refinement conjectures (some proven, some `oops`). This is substantial formal mathematical content—definitions, locale hierarchies, process algebra specifications, and proofs—relevant to the primary search index.
